title.en: Automate DR infrastructure build or pre-deploy DR resources

summary.en: Automate the build of disaster recovery (DR) infrastructure (or pre-deploy DR resources) and streamline SAP service recovery as much as possible.

rationale.en: Versioned, staged deployment makes a replacement reproducible and separates preparation from traffic cutover. Validation must cover configuration, identity, state and warmup, because a successfully created resource can still be unusable.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: SAP recovery infrastructure.
Confirm the source-specific deployment model, supported migration or swap operations and treatment of persistent and ephemeral state.
applicability.ko: 권고에 맞는 배포 모델, 지원되는 이전 또는 교환 작업과 영속 및 임시 상태의 처리 방식을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: Use the supported SAP, OS and database HA design. Synchronous local HA, asynchronous DR, fencing, load-balancer probes and shared files are not interchangeable.
applicability.ko: 지원되는 SAP, OS와 데이터베이스 HA 설계를 사용합니다. 동기 로컬 HA, 비동기 DR, 펜싱, 부하 분산기 프로브와 공유 파일은 서로 바꿔 쓸 수 없습니다.

applicability.en: The source classifies this specialized workload under a subscription. The actual objects to inspect are the SAP recovery infrastructure targets and their dependencies, not a subscription setting assumed to implement the recommendation.

title.en: Plan for backend maintenance by using connection draining

summary.en: Using connection draining for backend maintenance ensures graceful removal of backend pool members during updates or health issues. It's enabled via Backend Setting and applies to all members during rule creation.

title.en: Use Managed Disks for VM disks

summary.en: Azure is retiring unmanaged disks on September 30, 2025. Users should plan the migration to avoid disruptions and maintain service reliability.

rationale.en: Storage placement determines persistence, sharing, throughput and failure coupling. Shared, ephemeral, OS, data and profile storage have different semantics; use the supported layout for the exact workload rather than applying one disk rule everywhere.
rationale.ko: 저장 위치는 영속성, 공유, 처리량과 장애 결합을 결정합니다. 공유, 임시, OS, 데이터와 프로필 저장소는 의미가 다르므로 하나의 디스크 규칙을 모두에 적용하지 말고 정확한 워크로드가 지원하는 배치를 사용합니다.

title.en: Recover from Structured Streaming query failures

summary.en: Structured Streaming ensures fault-tolerance and data consistency in streaming queries. With Azure Databricks workflows, you can set up your queries to automatically restart after failure, picking up precisely where they left off.

rationale.en: Durable checkpoints, task state and failure destinations let a pipeline resume without silently losing work. Recovery must account for already committed outputs, schema compatibility and how partially completed tasks are replayed.

title.en: Do not Store any Production Data in Default DBFS Folders

title.en: Use Zone-redundant or Geo-zone-redundant Backup storage redundancy

summary.en: Configuring zone redundancy option for backups copies your backup file synchronously across three Azure availability zones in the primary region. If Geo is selected, then it copies your data asynchronously three times to a single physical location in the paired secondary region.

rationale.en: A backup retains recoverable state independently of the current live copy. Protection is demonstrated by successful recovery points and a usable restoration procedure, not by a policy assignment or a recent backup-job start.

title.en: Secure your Origin with Private Link in Azure Front Door

summary.en: Azure Private Link enables secure access to Azure PaaS and services over a private endpoint in your virtual network, ensuring traffic goes over the Microsoft backbone network, not the public internet.

rationale.en: Private access joins a client network, a name-resolution path and a service-specific private connection. An approved endpoint without correct DNS or an allowed data path does not provide usable private connectivity.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Cdn/profiles. Specific focus: Front Door private origin.
Check service and tier support, required subresources, endpoint approval, private DNS zones and client network topology.
applicability.ko: 서비스와 계층의 지원, 필요한 하위 리소스, 엔드포인트 승인, Private DNS 영역과 클라이언트 네트워크 구조를 확인합니다.

applicability.en: Front Door routes, origin probes, WAF and origin identity serve different purposes. A single-origin probe policy must be interpreted with the actual origin group, not copied to multi-origin failover.

before.en: Clients may use a public path or resolve a private name to an address they cannot reach.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Premium-tier Private Link support, connection approval and origin access restrictions. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

summary.en: Use Run command to take a snapshot of HCX Manager before making any critical changes to HCX Manager. Additionally, capture snapshot for HCX Manager before initiating a maintenance activity.

rationale.en: A backup retains recoverable state independently of the current live copy. Protection is demonstrated by successful recovery points and a usable restoration procedure, not by a policy assignment or a recent backup-job start.
rationale.ko: 백업은 현재 운영 사본과 별도로 복구 가능한 상태를 보존합니다. 정책 할당이나 작업 시작 기록만으로 보호 상태를 판단하지 않고, 성공한 복구 지점과 실제로 사용할 수 있는 복원 절차를 확인합니다.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Subscription/subscriptions. Specific focus: HCX pre-change snapshot.
Identify the exact supported data or configuration objects, consistency requirements, retention, recovery location and encryption-key dependencies.
applicability.ko: 지원되는 데이터와 구성 개체, 일관성 조건, 보존 기간, 복구 위치와 암호화 키 의존성을 확인합니다.

applicability.en: AVS private-cloud and cluster limits, vSAN storage policy, HCX and ExpressRoute have separate support boundaries. Validate the current vendor-supported topology.
applicability.ko: AVS 프라이빗 클라우드와 클러스터 한도, vSAN 저장소 정책, HCX와 ExpressRoute는 지원 경계가 다릅니다. 현재 공급업체가 지원하는 구조를 검증합니다.

applicability.en: The source classifies this specialized workload under a subscription. The actual objects to inspect are the HCX pre-change snapshot targets and their dependencies, not a subscription setting assumed to implement the recommendation.
applicability.ko: 원본은 이 전문 워크로드를 구독 아래 분류합니다. 실제 점검 대상은 권고에 명시된 리소스와 그 의존성입니다. 구독 설정 하나가 권고를 구현한다고 가정하지 않습니다.

applicability.en: The HCX source specifically names a pre-change snapshot of HCX Manager using the supported Run command.

before.en: Live data or configuration may have no recent recoverable copy, or recovery has not been demonstrated.
before.ko: 운영 데이터나 구성에 최근 복구 사본이 없거나 복구 가능성을 확인하지 않았을 수 있습니다.

before.en: Recommendation-specific baseline to inspect: Supported HCX backup or snapshot is taken before the planned operation and can be restored. This is an inspection question, not a finding about the current environment.

after.en: The intended objects have successful retained recovery points and a documented, tested restoration path.
after.ko: 보호 대상에 성공한 복구 지점을 보존하고 문서화된 복원 경로를 시험합니다.

after.en: Intended source-specific outcome: Create a HCX Snapshot ahead of either a maintenance activity or a crucial HCX operation. Validate using: Supported HCX backup or snapshot is taken before the planned operation and can be restored.

implementation_steps.en: Identify actual HCX pre-change snapshot target objects inside the workload's subscription scope and read their specific current configuration. Subscription classification is not a substitute for identifying host pools, shares, clusters or other real targets.
Select the service-supported protection mechanism and schedule, protect required keys and metadata, and arrange a nonproduction restore target with suitable permissions.
implementation_steps.ko: 서비스가 지원하는 보호 방식과 일정을 선택하고 필요한 키와 메타데이터를 보존합니다. 적절한 권한을 가진 비운영 복원 대상을 준비합니다.

implementation_steps.en: Prepare the supported HCX Manager snapshot before the maintenance or critical operation and document vendor-supported restore and snapshot cleanup.

Review the pinned APRL action 'Create a HCX Snapshot ahead of either a maintenance activity or a crucial HCX operation' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.

Prepare independent observations for: Supported HCX backup or snapshot is taken before the planned operation and can be restored. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Supported HCX backup or snapshot is taken before the planned operation and can be restored.
Inspect the snapshot target, successful completion and pre-change timestamp; confirm restore prerequisites rather than claiming that a snapshot is a complete AVS backup.
Check job completion and recovery-point freshness, restore a representative object into an isolated target, and verify application-level consistency and measured recovery time.
verification_steps.ko: 작업 완료와 복구 지점의 최신성을 확인합니다. 대표 개체를 격리된 대상에 복원하고 애플리케이션 수준의 일관성과 실제 복구 시간을 검증합니다.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed HCX pre-change snapshot behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.
verification_steps.ko: 기존의 자동, 수동, blocked 또는 미지원 평가 상태를 별도로 유지합니다. 정보가 없으면 알 수 없음으로 남깁니다. 그림, 설정 쓰기나 API 수락은 운영 성공이 아닙니다.

cautions.en: A snapshot, replication relationship and independently retained backup have different failure coverage. Do not promise regional recovery unless the specific protection mechanism supports it.
cautions.ko: 스냅샷, 복제 관계, 독립적으로 보존한 백업은 보호하는 장애 범위가 다릅니다. 해당 방식의 지원 여부를 확인하지 않고 지역 복구를 약속하지 않습니다.

cautions.en: The pinned APRL description and benefits are English-source metadata with explicit English fallback, not an independently verified Korean translation. Current product support must be checked before use.
